_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for simple-but-effective, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). units: per unit entry, its abilities’ When targeted lines (def, AI-written, with defOf) and why (the reasons for what the list shows). Only what GW tags (Aura) is an aura (Core Rules 22.01). Orks have no GW Faction Pack: the codex as Wahapedia transcribes it is GW’s words. Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.
caseNamesWhy: GW’s capitalisation of the ability, as Wahapedia’s Ghazghkull Thraka datasheet prints it (“Prophet of da Great Waaagh! (Aura)”), where New Recruit’s and BSData’s differ only in case (“Prophet of Da Great Waaagh!”): the review’s ruling (result-orks-data.json 9b257408614449af; ability names follow GW, as Chittering swarm in U w0t m8?)
keptRowsWhy: The owner retired the lists Melee and Ooga booga for this one (“remove Melee Orks list and Ooga Booga lists, this is the new ultimate melee orks list”): these datasheet rows were theirs and are now this list’s alone; their signed-off facts (words, labels, When targeted lines, notes) stay the app’s, as for a row another list has (from-json.js keptRows).

Super Runts (“This unit is riled up”, “This unit’s Scavenged Shivs weapons have +1 A, WS and S”): the attached unit, Core Rules 19.04. Extra Sneaky (Runt Swarm, UPGRADE: GRETCHIN unit only) is the Gretchin’s. That’ll Learn Ya in GW’s words (“This unit is no longer battle-shocked”; BSData: “That unit”).
